speaker: Doctor
text: I'm sorry to hear you're feeling unwell. To help me understand your condition better, can you tell me how many weeks pregnant you are and when your symptoms first started?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that detail. Given the sudden onset of fever and headache after eating ice cream, have you experienced any skin lesions, a stiff neck, or sensitivity to light? Also, have you noticed any changes in your vision or severe abdominal pain?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever. I also have Headache, Anorexia, Fatigue, Malaise.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Viremia of Listeria monocytogenes (Listeriosis).

Based on your 30-week pregnancy, sudden onset of fever, headache, and anorexia following the consumption of unpasteurized dairy (ice cream), you likely have Listeria infection. Please confirm if you have any nausea, vomiting, or abdominal cramping, and I will request a blood culture and stool sample immediately. REQUEST TEST: Blood_Culture, Stool_Culture, CBC, CMP.
